description: Sitara Chemical Industries Limited operates what its chief executive describes as the largest chlor-alkali chemical complex in Pakistan, at 32 km on the Sheikhupura Road outside Faisalabad. The company commissioned its plant in 1981 and has grown production capacity from 30 tonnes a day in 1984 to 630 tonnes a day, with annual turnover above Rs 30 billion.
sourceNote: Company website (sitara.com.pk: corporate-profile, ceo-profile), read 2026-10-17; commissioning date from the Sitara Peroxide Limited website, which records Sitara's entry into chemicals in 1981.
